SMTO-SKL-0069 — SMTO can't change attachments while editing a draft

GUID: 9be498c2-1383-5c8c-8b75-e62adf295f23
Slug: microsoft365-draft-attachment-update-unsupported
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • SMTO can change a draft email's text and recipients, but not swap its attachments in the same step. Your draft was left as it was.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to add the file to the existing draft as its own step, for example "add report.pdf to my draft to Sam". Remove attachments the same way. Adding or removing one attachment at a time on a draft is supported, while replacing all of them during an edit isn't.
  2. If you prefer, ask SMTO to create a new draft with the text and all the attachments you want. A new draft can include every attachment from the start.
  3. Open Outlook Drafts and check the draft before sending. Delete the old draft only if you made a new one and no longer need it. Checking avoids sending the wrong version or leaving two similar drafts.

What success looks like

  • Outlook Drafts shows one draft with the right text and attachments.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Microsoft 365 draft update included a non-empty attachments list, but updating an existing draft cannot replace its attachments.

What this means

  • An existing draft update includes a nonempty attachment list, which this path does not support replacing. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • An existing draft update includes a nonempty attachment list, which this path does not support replacing.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect whether the operation targets an existing draft and supplies attachments.

How to fix it

  • Call mail_update_draft without attachments, and add or remove attachments with mail_attachment_add and mail_attachment_delete on the draft. Alternatively create a replacement draft with the complete attachment list, review it, then delete the old draft only if intended.
  • Create a replacement draft with the complete attachment list, review it, then delete the old draft if intended.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A reviewed deliberate replacement draft contains the full intended list without sending or deleting unexpectedly.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.
